source: nflverse play-by-play; current-season completed games refreshed daily, with corrections; historical seasons retain their dated snapshots. See data.coverage for exact games, source hash and timestamps.
note: Aggregated by the PRIMARY BALL HANDLER: the passer on a dropback, the ball carrier on a rush. There is no receiving EPA here and there cannot be — the play-by-play snapshot carries one name per play, so the whole value of a completed pass is credited to the quarterback and a receiver appears only for his own carries. Regular season only, plays with a down. Descriptive aggregates, not projections: do not read 2025 as 2026. 2026 is Weeks 1-9 ONLY (136 games): incomplete-season coverage, with the season minimums prorated to 75 dropbacks / 38 rushes. The pooled table spans every season in the snapshot, including the partial one.

field_notes.epa_per_play: EPA per play over everything he handled the ball on
field_notes.epa_per_dropback: EPA per dropback as the passer; null if he never dropped back
field_notes.epa_per_rush: EPA per carry as the ball carrier; null if he never carried it
field_notes.cpoe: completion percentage over expected, percentage points; passers only
field_notes.teams: present only when he handled the ball for more than one team in the period
field_notes.total_epa: unrated sum, so it rewards volume — read it beside the per-play rates, not instead of them

2026.rule: full-season bar x weeks covered / 17, rounded up

2026.note: Completed games only, including incomplete weeks. Daily published nflverse EPA; not live. Historical seasons retained; current-season corrections incorporated.

data.minimum_rule: a player is included if he clears EITHER the dropback bar or the rush bar
unavailable: receiving EPA (no receiver is named on any play)
blocking, and every other lineman contribution
defensive players (only the defending TEAM is recorded)
special teams and plays with no down
opponent adjustment and game-state adjustment beyond what EPA already carries

tier_meaning: Working Dawg — earned its collar. Evidence survived validation: receipts against a benchmark chosen in advance for forecasters, named sources and reproducible maths for measurement tools.
